title: The browser shows a batch 429 busy answer as the daily limit
evidence: widget-src/src/lib/upload-api.ts labImportBatch maps every 429 to "Daily upload limit reached" (errorCode rate_limit), so the route's "Server busy" 429 (200 batches, or a fourth re-pick of one batch under US-12 AC25) reads as the daily limit and upload_outcome counts it as one. A distinct busy code the browser can map would need its own words
